priority: P1 — verificar que qualquer participante convidado pode recusar um lobby 2v2 parcialmente aceito, liberando todos os locks em uma única transição e impedindo replay de botão cancelado.

behavior.partialConsent: Host plus two invited participants have accepted; the fourth invitee can decline using the current public cancel custom_id.
behavior.ackOrdering: The real handler defers before cancellation and the test observes all three existing locks still present at acknowledgement.
behavior.lockRelease: The cancelled revision removes every tag_members lock; currentTag returns undefined for all four seats.
behavior.publicRefresh: The handler edits a terminal public payload with no live components and refreshes the public session once.
behavior.staleReplay: Replaying the old cancel custom_id after cancellation is acknowledged but rejected without another revision, edit, refresh or lock change.
behavior.economy: players, player_cards and starter_grants remain unchanged.

security.discord: handler/builders reais offline; sem token, guild ou canal real

limitations: Interação Discord offline; não chama API ou guild real.
Cobertura limitada ao cancelamento de lobby antes de iniciar a partida.
Não altera runtime nem certifica cartas.
